This handoff's push carries `skip-checks: true`, correctly: it touches `.legion/INFRA-879/test.json` alone. `ci.yaml` runs `on: pull_request` in the concurrency group `ci-<pull request number>` with `cancel-in-progress`, and a trailered push starts no run, so it cancels none either — run 41381600365 at c3e73039410e keeps running after this push. The pull request's own head then carries no check until retro's push, which never carries the trailer for exactly that reason.

Tester harness in this pod: `bun install` at the repository root (it rewrites bun.lock's pi-envoy and pi-legion versions, pre-existing drift on main — restore it with `jj restore bun.lock`), `cd packages/contracts && bun run build` (Playwright reads @legion/contracts through dist/), `bunx playwright install chromium` with PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH left unset, a database of your own for DATABASE_URL and another for DISPATCH_TEST_DATABASE_URL/BROKER_TEST_DATABASE_URL, and the spec file written before --project.
